method: the same calls against both binaries; the journal's recorded program is read back from the journal itself, never from the report of the command under test — the report is the thing that lied. A defect case is violated when the identity CHANGED, or when the disagreement was not refused in reeflog's own voice naming BOTH programs (exit codes cannot tell: a baseline `verify` that silently ignored the flag still ends in an INCOMPLETE scan). A guard case is violated when the identity changed or the guard met an identity refusal.
